articles.description: Google na jedné straně konečně povolil alternativní obchody s aplikacemi na Androidu, na straně druhé však vyžaduje od všech vývojářů od září letošního roku, aby se zaregistrovali, ukázali platné ID a platili poplatek 25 dolarů za rok. Proti tomu se bouří vývojáři, kteří doposud nepoužívali Google Play, ale například F-Droid, který se specializuje na open source aplikace.
articles.title: Petice za otevřený Android

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Na některých počítačích Samsung Galaxy Book 4 a Samsung Desktop se uživatelé nemohli dostat na disk C: ve Windows 11. Zjistilo se, že na vině je aplikace Samsung Galaxy Connect, která má sdílet soubory a přenášet obrazovku mezi Windows a mobilním zařízením Samsung Galaxy.
articles.title: Aplikace Samsung Galaxy Connect blokovala přístup na C: ve Windows 11

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Nejen rozpínání rozpínání vesmíru – Hubbleovu konstantu můžeme určit i ze stáří prvních hvězd. Vytvořili krajně exotickou molekulu a pomocí kvantového počítání prokázali její povahu. Kde bral vznikající život dusík?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Záhadné neutrino s rekordní energií mohlo mít původ v blazarech

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Epson EF-62N: Přenosné 4K kino se zvukem od Bose a bez starostí s nastavením. Acer má za sebou 50 let a před sebou éru AI notebooků. Acronis Cyberthreats Report: Eskalace phishingu, ransomwaru a hrozeb založených na AI. Sophos Active Adversary Report 2026: Dominují útoky na identitu. Virtuozzo sjednocuje své cloudové technologie do jedné produktové platformy. Software bude důležitější než kdy dřív. Huawei uvádí komplexní portfolio, které otevírá cestu k 6G.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Software bude důležitější než kdy dřív

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Ať už stále sedíte u žejdlíku tradičního Březňáka (Märzen) nebo vína či kafíčka, vychutnejte si přitom také skvělé ceny Windows 11 Pro, Office 2019 nebo her na stránkách Goodoffer24.com!
articles.title: Březnové softwarové šílenství pokračuje!

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 11/2026

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Za vymírání v ordoviku a devonu prý mohly blízké supernovy. Matematické modelování vysvětluje, proč se některé přechody pro chodce mění v chaos. Toyota testuje supravodivost ve vodíkovém pohonu.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Standardní model obstál, vzácný rozpad kaonu přesně odpovídá předpovědi

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: TCL NXTPAPER 11 Plus: Konec kompromisů mezi tabletem a čtečkou knih. AI v simulacích jaderných krizí: Eskalace místo diplomacie. Sektor IT a podnikových služeb v ČR dosáhl 200 tisíc zaměstnanců. Kybernetická bezpečnost se stává osobní záležitostí vedení firem. Levné a rychlé útoky s pomocí AI obcházejí současnou obranu. Globální výdaje na ICT dosáhnou letos 4 bilionů dolarů. Od AI asistenta po skutečně inteligentní ERP platformu. SAP AI Core se přímo zapojuje do fungování firem. Analýza kybernetických rizik: z povinnosti výhoda. Chytré město stojí na datech, ne na aplikacích.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: AI v simulacích jaderných krizí – Eskalace místo diplomacie

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Podivný planetární systém „naruby“ s vnější kamennou planetou. Čeští vědci zaznamenali na Marsu elektrický výboj připomínající blesky. Monogamie vznikla kvůli dědictví, ne kvůli stabilitě společnosti.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Rychlost rozpínání vesmíru by se mohla měřit i z gravitačních vln

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 10/2026

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Ať už pijete tradiční pivo Märzen (Březňák) nebo ne, mrkněte přitom také na březnové výprodejní ceny na stránce Goodoffer24.com s Windows 11 Pro, Office 2019 nebo herním softwarem! Jednoduše klikněte na předchozí link nebo jděte rovnou na stránku Goodoffer24.com.
articles.title: Šílený březnový výprodej

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: HPE představuje nové routery Juniper PTX. Umělá inteligence pomáhá řešit i problémy, kterým sama nerozumí. Umělá inteligence nemá člověka nahradit, ale doplnit. Budoucnost datových center: co jsou to mikro-hyper cloudy? Čeští vědci vyvinuli systém, který zvyšuje spolehlivost energetických a komunikačních sítí. Profesionální monitor, který přepisuje pravidla kancelářské třídy. Fortinet rozšiřuje řešení FortiCNAPP, pomáhá řešit rizika cloudu.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Čeští vědci vyvinuli systém, který zvyšuje spolehlivost energetických a komunikačních sítí

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Šok: Mohla by být v centru Mléčné dráhy místo černé díry temná hmota? Mohou primordiální magnetická pole vyřešit záhadu Hubbleovy konstanty? Antarktida leží nad nejsilnější gravitační dírou na Zemi. Jak k tomu došlo?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Umělá inteligence kopíruje vědce, má své výsledky umět zdůvodňovat

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: KiCad (Wikipedie), sada svobodných softwarových nástrojů pro počítačový návrh elektronických zařízení (EDA), byl vydán v nové major verzi 10.0.0 (𝕏). Přehled novinek v příspěvku na blogu.
articles.title: KiCad 10.0.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Letošní Turingovou cenu (2025 ACM A.M. Turing Award, Nobelova cena informatiky) získali Charles H. Bennett a Gilles Brassard za základní přínosy do oboru kvantové informatiky, které převrátily pojetí bezpečné neprolomitelné komunikace a výpočetní techniky. Jejich protokol BB84 z roku 1984 umožnil fyzikálně zaručený bezpečný přenos šifrovacích klíčů, zatímco jejich práce o kvantové teleportaci položila teoretické základy pro budoucí kvantový internet. Jejich práce spojila fyziku s informatikou a ovlivnila celou generaci vědců.
articles.title: Letošní Turingovou cenu (2025 ACM A.M. Turing Award) získali Charles H. Bennett a Gilles Brassard

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Firefox 149 dostupný od 24. března přinese bezplatnou vestavěnou VPN s 50 GB přenesených dat měsíčně (s CZ a SK se zatím nepočítá) a zobrazení dvou webových stránek vedle sebe v jednom panelu (split view). Firefox Labs 149 umožní přidat poznámky k panelům (tab notes, videoukázka).
articles.title: Novinky ve Firefoxu 149

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová stabilní verze 7.9 webového prohlížeče Vivaldi (Wikipedie). Postavena je na Chromiu 146. Přehled novinek i s náhledy v příspěvku na blogu.
articles.title: Vivaldi 7.9

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Dle plánu byla vydána Opera GX pro Linux. Ke stažení je .deb i .rpm. V plánu je flatpak. Opera GX je webový prohlížeč zaměřený na hráče počítačových her.
articles.title: Opera GX už také pro Linux

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: GNUnet (Wikipedie) byl vydán v nové major verzi 0.27.0. Jedná se o framework pro decentralizované peer-to-peer síťování, na kterém je postavena řada aplikací.
articles.title: GNUnet 0.27.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description:
Byly publikovány informace (technické detaily) o bezpečnostním problému Snapu. Jedná se o CVE-2026-3888. 
Neprivilegovaný lokální uživatel může s využitím snap-confine a systemd-tmpfiles získat práva roota.
articles.title: Bezpečnostní problém Snapu (CVE-2026-3888)

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Nightingale je open-source karaoke aplikace, která z jakékoliv písničky lokálního alba (včetně videí) dokáže oddělit vokály, získat text a vše přehrát se synchronizací na úrovni jednotlivých slov a hodnocením intonace. Pro separaci vokálů využívá UVR Karaoke model s Demucs od Mety, texty písní stahuje z lrclib.net (LRCLIB), případně extrahuje pomocí whisperX, který rovněž využívá k načasování slov. V případě audiosouborů aplikace na pozadí zobrazuje jednoduché shaderové efekty, alternativně volná videa z Pixabay. Zdrojový kód je dostupný na GitHubu.
articles.title: Karaoke aplikace Nightingale

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Po půl roce vývoje od vydání verze 49 bylo vydáno GNOME 50 s kódovým názvem Tokyo (Mastodon). Podrobný přehled novinek i s náhledy v poznámkách k vydání a v novinkách pro vývojáře.
articles.title: GNOME 50

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Článek na stránkách Fedora Magazinu informuje o vydání Fedora Asahi Remixu 43, tj. linuxové distribuce pro Apple Silicon vycházející z Fedora Linuxu 43.

March 20th has activated the Destroy Exospire mission in Helldivers 2, and it involves taking down the storm formations on planet Seasse. However, the job is easier said than done, and you can expect plenty of enemies that will try to disrupt your attempt. Let's look at how to easily complete the new quest that arrives as part of the Machinery of Oppression update.


Helldivers 2 Destroy Exospire walkthrough


Image via Arrowhead


Once you accept the quest from the terminal, head to Seasse to begin the quest. The Exospire is a massive-purple colored structure that is almost impossible to miss. When you reach its base, you'll realize that a giant shield blocks the entrance. You have to take this shield down before you can proceed further.


Image via Arrowhead


First, look for the sub-objective that requires you to disrupt a Shield Generator. You'll find the generator close to the Exospire. Keep shooting at the generator's shield until it gets destroyed. Next, destroy the generator by calling the Data Jack stratagem. Once the stratagem becomes active, enemies will start spawning on you.


Image via Arrowhead


To complete the process, you'll need to clear all enemies. Finally, initiate the power surge to bring down the shield that restricts you from entering the base of the Exospire. Once inside, you'll have to destroy 148 Dark Fluid Cells. These cells are on the walls, and you can start to shoot at them. However, you'll also have to be mindful of enemies who will try to stop you from succeeding.


The core will become completely destabilized when all the Dark Fluid Cells are destroyed. The core will then explode, and your task will be complete. When the core explodes, try to run as far away as possible. Otherwise, you'll get eliminated by the explosion (the task will still be completed irrespective of the results).

The post How to complete Destroy Exospire in Helldivers 2 appeared first on Destructoid.

How to partner with Agents of Atlas members for 10 KOs in Marvel Rivals


Screenshot by Destructoid

As White Fox, partner with Agents of Atlas members to land 10 KOs.



Currently, the only other members of Agents of Atlas in Marvel Rivals are Luna Snow and Iron Fist. To get this achievement, simply play as White Fox alongside Luna Snow or Iron Fist to combine for some kills. This achievement is quick to finish once you have the right teammates and know which heroes you have to combo with.


An easy way to do this is to play the 18-vs-18 Conquest mode, which is basically a massive team deathmatch. Play as White Fox and either have some friends, random teammates, or bots play as Luna Snow or Iron Fist, and you should unlock the achievement in no time.

articles.description:
Crimson Desert is now available on PC and console, and if you're on the former platform, you can gain access to the save file quite easily.


Thanks to the different puzzles and quests, things can go wrong quite quickly on your save. While you can create multiple saves at different points, you can also manually create a backup. To do so, you'll need to access the save file from where it's stored on the PC.


How to find the Crimson Desert save file on your PC


The storage location for Crimson Desert save files will be in the root drive of your system. While you can manually change the location from Steam settings (game properties), I assume you're yet to do that. If you're using the default settings, here's the path for finding all the save files.



C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Local\Pearl Abyss\CD\save



The path for you will be the same, with only the change being for the <Username>. This folder will be located in your root drive (which is the C drive for my PC).


Once you reach the path, you'll find the save folder. Open it, and there will be two subfolders within. The numbered folder contains all the save files that you'll create inside the game.


Screenshot by Destructoid


If you want to manually create a backup for whatever reason it might be, you need to remove the save file and store it in a safe place. That way, you can also use it as a restore point if you overwrite the save file in the game.


While I haven't tested it out, you should be able to use the save file of another player. This is possible since Crimson Desert is a single-player exclusive experience. However, I have yet to test this method out as of writing. What I have tested, however, is that you can manually create backups of your own save file and use them to restore past progression.

The post Crimson Desert save file location on PC appeared first on Destructoid.

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Winning the Best Picture Oscar is usually a reliable piracy trigger, and this year is no exception.  The estimated pirated downloads of 'One Battle After Another' tripled on torrent sites, leaving all other contenders behind. Surprisingly, 'Sinners' saw no piracy boost post-ceremony despite four Oscar wins and a record sixteen nominations.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Oscar Winner ‘One Battle After Another’ Sees Piracy Surge, While ‘Sinners’ Stays Flat

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Italy’s "Piracy Shield" was designed to stop pirated live sports streams in 30 minutes, but Cloudflare says the "black box" system also puts the open Internet at risk. The American company was fined €14 million by Italian regulator AGCOM in january, for refusing to filter through its 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver. This week, Cloudflare announced that it formally appealed the fine while it continues to challenge the legality of the Piracy Shield system.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare Challenges Legality of Italy’s “Piracy Shield”, Appeals €14 Million Fine

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Apple has won its legal battle against music streaming app Musi. A California federal court dismissed the case with prejudice, ruling that Apple had a clear contractual right to remove the app from the App Store. In a separate order, the court also sanctioned Musi's lawyers for a factually baseless allegation in the amended complaint.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Dismisses Musi’s Apple Lawsuit, Sanctions Law Firm for “Baseless” Claims

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Delaware bankruptcy court approved the legal framework for a $100 million+ sale of Redbox' piracy litigation rights. While a final deal is still being negotiated, the intended buyer of these rights plans to use them to sue Internet providers for failing to disconnect accounts of alleged BitTorrent pirates. Whether this strategy will pay off is highly dependent on a pending Supreme Court decision.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Bankruptcy Court Clears Path for $100 Million Sale of Redbox’s Piracy Lawsuit Rights

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 03/16/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Online piracy continues to be a major problem for rightsholders, especially those who rely on exclusive live streaming content. This challenge is worsened by dedicated sharing communities on Telegram, Discord, and elsewhere, which can be harder to spot. To tackle this, the Czech anti-piracy company Warezio is offering the public rewards for snitching on pirates through the new gamified "Online Hunter" portal.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Rightsholders Crowdsource Piracy Link Reporting With ‘Online Hunter’ Game

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Since 2024, HiAnime.to has been a primary destination for millions of anime viewers. Today, this reign appears to come to an end as a message shown across its official domain names says that it's "time to say goodbye". However, not everyone is convinced that this is indeed a final farewell.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Giant HiAnime.to Announces Mysterious ‘Goodbye’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A federal judge in Texas has signed a default judgment ordering Dallas IPTV operator William Freemon to pay $18,750,000 in copyright damages to Amazon, Netflix, and several major Hollywood studios. The eight domains associated with his pirate streaming network must now be transferred to the movie companies.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Officially Orders U.S.-Based IPTV Operator to Pay Amazon & Netflix $18.75 Million

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A California federal court dismissed the copyright infringement lawsuit DISH Network filed against hosting provider Innetra, finding it lacked personal jurisdiction over the UK company. DISH accused the company of providing infrastructure to pirate IPTV operations while ignoring DMCA takedown requests. The case was dismissed without prejudice, leaving open the possibility of future action elsewhere.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Dismisses DISH’s $25 Million IPTV Piracy Lawsuit Against UK Hosting Provider

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Illinois-based musician Anthony Martino is suing the Internet Archive for copyright infringement over its Myspace Dragon Hoard collection. This 490,000 MP3 collection was created from recordings that were lost in Myspace's 2019 server disaster. According to Martino, his music ended up in the collection without his authorization. Meanwhile, the Internet Archive denies wrongdoing and says it is protected by the DMCA safe harbor.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Internet Archive Faces Copyright Lawsuit Over ‘Myspace Dragon Hoard’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A coalition of thirteen major publishers, including Penguin Random House, Elsevier, and HarperCollins, filed a new lawsuit against Anna’s Archive. The publishers allege the shadow library is facilitating "staggering" levels of piracy. While the site's owners are not likely to put up a defense, the publishers' main goal appears to be to obtain an injunction that can apply further pressure on domain registrars and registries.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Major Publishers Sue Anna’s Archive Over ‘Staggering’ Copyright Infringement, Seek Injunction

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Italy's crackdown on pirate IPTV subscribers has reached a new milestone. After thousands were fined by the state, football league Serie A has now collected additional €1,000 damages settlements from a number of the same people. There may be more trouble ahead, as Serie A's CEO warns that this is only the beginning.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Italian IPTV Pirates Pay €1,000 in Damages to Football League Serie A

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
To help train AI models, Meta and other tech companies have downloaded and shared pirated books via BitTorrent from Anna's Archive and other shadow libraries. In an ongoing lawsuit, Meta now argues that uploading pirated books to strangers via BitTorrent qualifies as fair use.  The company also stresses that the data helped establish U.S. global leadership in AI.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Uploading Pirated Books via BitTorrent Qualifies as Fair Use, Meta Argues

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
With millions of monthly visits, P-stream was a popular pirate streaming portal, providing free access to movies and TV series. The project launched in 2024 following the shutdown of a similar service, movie-web, which was eventually shut down by legal pressure from Hollywood. Today, P-Stream follows the same path, taking down the website, after a DMCA subpoena from the MPA/ACE targeted Cloudflare.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Streaming Portal ‘P-Stream’ Shuts Down Following ACE/MPA Pressure

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Office of the United States Trade Representative has published its annual list of problematic piracy websites and other "notorious markets." With the FIFA World Cup coming to North America this summer, this year's report puts a special focus on live sports broadcast piracy. The USTR hopes that by naming these platforms, operators and foreign governments will take appropriate action.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Lists Notorious Piracy Threats, With Focus on Sports Streaming

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
YggTorrent, the largest francophone torrent community, has shut down permanently following a devastating hack. The cyberattack compromised YggTorrent's infrastructure, wiped key information, and drained the site's crypto wallets. The hacker publicly published the site's data online in a massive 11+ GB archive, noting that this could be of interest to law enforcement. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: YggTorrent Shuts Down After Hack, Leak and Stolen Crypto

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Anna’s Archive lost its .li domain a few hours ago, likely due to legal pressure. The shadow library's domain name was outright deleted instead of suspended. Whether the domain registrar or registry is responsible is unknown, but the latter seems more plausible. Anna's Archive was briefly down to one remaining domain name, but several new ones were swiftly added.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Loses .LI Domain As Legal Pressure Mounts

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Nearly two years after several Hollywood studios, Amazon, and Netflix sued a Dallas IPTV operator for running a pirate streaming network, a magistrate judge now recommends an $18.75 million default judgment. The defendant tried various unorthodox methods to make the case go away, including a demand for money from the movie companies, but these efforts all failed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Hollywood, Amazon & Netflix Set to Secure $18.75 Million Damages in IPTV Lawsuit

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
UEFA has obtained a broad blocking injunction at the High Court of Delhi, targeting 79 pirate streaming domains that reportedly attracted two billion annual visits. Obtained in cooperation with anti-piracy coalition ACE, the order compels Indian ISPs and globally operating domain registrars to block or suspend the listed sites. Thus far, however, the results appear to be mixed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UEFA Secures Pirate Site Blocking and (Global) Domain Suspension Order in India

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (dckone)
articles.description:
Yippee-ki-yay! The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce support for the DOS versions of the following titles created by American Laser Games:
Crime Patrol
Crime Patrol 2: Drug Wars
The Last Bounty Hunter
Mad Dog McCree
Mad Dog II: The Lost Gold
Space Pirates
Who Shot Johnny Rock?
Grab your game CD (only DOS versions are supported currently), the daily build, shoot some baddies before they shoot you, and report any bugs you might encounter on your adventures.

>

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (whoozle)
articles.description:
Ancient evil stirs, the grim times approaching. And it's up to you, our brave investigator, to explore a haunted mansion and unravel the terrifying secrets of the Necronomicon before darkness consumes the world.
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Necronomicon: The Dawning of Darkness. This Cryo Interactive adventure from 2001 draws deep from the well of H.P. Lovecraft's works, casting players into creeping madness.
Grab your portion of the ScummVM daily build, prepare your copy of the game (or get it from Steam, roll up your sleeves, and dive into the unknown depths of this game.
And if you encounter any oddities (but not mishaps), please be kind to submit your bug report to our tracker.
Also, we are looking for some dedicated testers to help us complete development of another game on the same engine, The Cameron Files: The Secret at Loch Ness. We need someone who would repeatedly and patiently replay this game. If you are willing to help, please drop by our Discord Server and talk to the devs.
>

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sev)
articles.description:
This year we are also coming with the good news: We've been accepted again to the Google Summer of Code program!
So, if you love Adventure games or RPGs and would like to spend your summer with our cool team, we look forward to your application and participation.
Fear not—we will provide enough handholding, explanations, and support if you can dedicate time to coding on our project, are an open-minded developer ready to learn, and do not hesitate to ask any questions. We've been doing GSoC for the last 19 years (can't believe it!), so we know the drill.
A list of suggested projects can be found on this page. If you have your own idea, we will gladly evaluate it. For example, this happened in 2023 with the Crab engine which is now fully supported. The required information for your application for our project is listed on our Wiki.
To give you a nice boost, we have put together an impressive amount of information on the Google Summer of Code miniportal. So you can learn all the ins and outs of the process. But indeed, you need to start by joining our Discord server and follow the #scummvm-gsoc channel where you can engage with our mentors and the rest of the team.
We are looking forward to your fine application and participation!
>

articles.description: I wanted to provide an update on the situation with OpenTTD on Steam and GOG, and what the Atari re-release of Transport Tycoon Deluxe means for OpenTTD. There has been a lot of speculation and, in some cases, misinformation spread about what has happened. Our initial announcement perhaps didn’t provide as much detail as we could have, but I want to reassure OpenTTD fans that we have not been “pressured” by Atari to make these changes.

Před pár dny dostal Oscara za dokumentární film dánsko-český snímek Pan nikdo proti Putinovi, který vypráví o tom, jak funguje ruská propaganda a odhaluje ruskou realitu.
V tomto dokumentárním filmu se v čase 32:01 mluví o sovětských gulazích, což je doprovázeno fotografií typického gulagu. Je to stará černobílá fotografie, na které vidíme vězně, vstupní bránu, a nad ní nápis "GULAG".


Záběr z dokumentu "Pan nikdo proti Putinovi" (čas 32:01)


Je na tom něco divného? Možná to, že nápis "GULAG" není v azbuce, ale v latince. Ale kdo ví, já se moc nevyznám v sovětské historii.
Ovšem docela se vyznám ve filmech s plyšovými žabáky, takže jsem viděl (shodou okolností v letadle do Japonska) hraný film z roku 2014 A zase ti Mupeti (Muppets Most Wanted), ve kterém se v čase 28:37 objeví tento zábě…

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Výborně, místy až geniálně režírovaný film. Ale s velmi slabým scénářem. Záplava hardcore vědeckých problémů se střídá s okamžiky, kdy se ignorují nejzákladnější fyzikální zákony a elementární logika. Chvíli "Příchozí", chvíli "Galaxy Quest". Není jasné, kdy v ději uplynul den a kdy rok. Mezi spoustou humoru téměř zaniká skutečnost, že se hraje o přežití nejméně jedné civilizace. Při "Lego Movie" nebo animovaném "Spider-Manovi" jsem se několikrát dojal. Při "Spasiteli" ani na sekundu, i když to tvůrci zjevně chtěli. Bohužel jsem nečetl knihu, takže netuším, jestli za to může Andy Weir nebo Drew Goddard. (Ilča 50 %)

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Před lety se mi hodně líbily filmy Terryho Gilliama tím, jak byly naprosto šílené. Dnes mi mnohé z nich přijdou až nesnesitelně pomalé. Tohle je Terry Gilliam pro 21. století, a zcela jistě záměrně (s mnohými odkazy na konkrétní Gilliamovy scény). (Ilča 100 %)

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Řemeslně a výtvarně OK, vtípky pro malé děti fungují, ale scénář je opravdu zoufalý. Jde o sérii klasických disneyovských minizápletek ("Chraň přírodu", "Buď sám sebou", "Obětuj se pro kamaráda", "Bojuj proti zlu"), které jsou propojeny nepříliš smysluplnými "Deus ex machina" náhodami a všemocnými vynálezy. Mnoho potenciálně zajímavých témat je zběžně nakousnuto a okamžitě zapomenuto. Jako celovečerní film to moc nefunguje a určitě by to bylo lepší jako televizní seriál. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Na skok do divočiny [Hoppers] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Film se dvěma výbornými hereckými výkony (Dano a Law), který selhává dvěma zásadními způsoby: 1) Jako rekonstrukce historických událostí vzbuzuje dojem, že Rusko a Putin byli k většině svých zvěrstev donuceni zlým zbytkem světa, nemohli se vlastně zachovat jinak a jediný "hlas vyspělé západní demokracie" (Wright) působí jako vyšinutý konspirační teoretik. 2) Smyšlený příběh hlavního smyšleného hrdiny (Dano) je veskrze nezajímavý a zbytečně natahovaný. Putin (Law) je mnohem zajímavější, ale poprvé se ve filmu objeví až po hodině. (Ilča 50 %)

articles.description: Prvních 15-20 minut je naprosto famózních a kdyby takhle vypadal celý film, nerozpakoval bych se dát mu absolutní hodnocení. Bohužel, zbývajících 80 minut je "jenom" velmi zručně sestříhaný (a do značné míry "zrekonstruovaný") záznam několika koncertů, jehož vychutnání bude velmi záviset na tom, do jaké míry je Elvis Presley vaším šálkem kávy. (Ilča 80 %)

articles.description:
USN-8103-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Exiv2. The update caused a regression
for Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and
Ubuntu 25.10. This update fixes the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle reading certain
 buffers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to leak sensitive
 information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04
 LTS. (CVE-2020-18771)

 Wen Cheng discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle certain memory
 allocation. If a user or system were tricked into opening a specially
 crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
 of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.
 (CVE-2020-18899)

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle writing certain
 metadata. If a user or system were tricked into opening a specially crafted
 file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
 service. (CVE-2025-54080)

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle parsing certain
 metadata. If a user or system were tricked into opening a specially crafted
 file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
 service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS,
 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 25.10. (CVE-2025-55304)

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle parsing certain
 images. If a user or system were tricked into opening a specially crafted
 file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
 service. (CVE-2026-25884)

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle previewing certain
 images. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
 service. (CVE-2026-27596)

 It was discovered that Exiv2 did not correctly handle certain integer
 arithmetic. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
 service. (CVE-2026-27631)
articles.title: USN-8103-2: Exiv2 regression

articles.description:
USN-8018-1 fixed CVE-2025-12084, CVE-2025-15282, CVE-2026-0672,
CVE-2026-0865 for python3. This update provides the corresponding updates
for python2.7.

Original advisory details:

 Denis Ledoux discovered that Python incorrectly parsed email message
 headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary
 headers into email messages. This issue only affected python3.6,
 python3.7,  python3.8, python3.9, python3.10, python3.11, python3.12,
 python3.13, and  python3.14 packages. (CVE-2025-11468)

 Jacob Walls, Shai Berger, and Natalia Bidart discovered that Python
 inefficiently parsed XML input with quadratic complexity. An attacker
 could  possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
 (CVE-2025-12084)

 It was discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious plist files. An
 attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Python to use excessive
 resources, leading to a denial of service. This issue only affected
 python3.5, python3.6, python3.7, python3.8, python3.9, python3.10,
 python3.11, python3.12, python3.13, and python3.14 packages.
 (CVE-2025-13837)

 Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed URL mediatypes. An
 attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary HTTP headers.
 (CVE-2025-15282)

 Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious IMAP
 inputs.  An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary
 IMAP  commands. (CVE-2025-15366)

 Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious POP3
 inputs.  An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary
 POP3  commands. (CVE-2025-15367)

 Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious HTTP cookie
 headers. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject arbitrary
 HTTP  headers. (CVE-2026-0672)

 Omar Hasan discovered that Python incorrectly parsed malicious HTTP header
 names and values. An attacker could possibly use this issue to inject
 arbitrary HTTP headers. (CVE-2026-0865)
articles.title: USN-8018-3: Python 2.7 vulnerabilities
